name: TimeframeWeekFlatContent
description: Flat list of selectable week items for the TimeframeControls week selector

props.name: visibleWeeks
props.description: Weeks to list, as returned by `weeksOfMonth(year, month, timezone)`

fields.name: start
fields.description: Monday 00:00:00.000 (local time) that opens the week

fields.name: end
fields.description: Sunday 23:59:59.999 (local time) that closes the week, capped to the end of yesterday

fields.name: label
fields.description: Option text, `DD/MM - DD/MM` in the selected timezone

fields.name: bucketYear
fields.description: Year of the week's end date in the selected timezone; sent as `year` to `onRangeChange`

fields.name: bucketMonth
fields.description: Month (0-11) of the week's end date in the selected timezone; sent as `month` to `onRangeChange`

fields.name: disabled
fields.description: True when the week starts after the end of yesterday; the option is shown but not selectable
